basic_info.description: The Millennium is back! Watch this video about the successful completion of the repair project: https://youtu.be/3BMzjNiFEaA. You'll be impressed by this 2-BR, 2-BA residence overlooking Salesforce Park. Bespoke upgrades include refinished oak floors, quartz counters, custom lower kitchen cabinets and backsplash, wine refrigerator, full-size washer/dryer, and custom lighting. A rain head enhances the primary shower, and the bedroom features both a well-appointed walk-in closet and a second closet. In addition to the building's valet service, this condo comes with a guaranteed parking space available for a monthly fee. Residents enjoy an impressive range of amenities designed to elevate urban living, including a 24-hour concierge and security. The massive Club Level is replete with a state-of-the-art 5,000+ sq. ft. fitness center, monthly wellness events, Pilates studio, yoga room, screening center, saltwater lap pool, and adjacent spa. The owner's lounge is ideal for entertaining or unwinding. Outdoor terraces, bike storage, a business center, and conference room add further convenience. Adjacent to the Transbay Terminal, this location offers unmatched transit access. The Ferry Building and Union Square are just minutes away. See disclosures for details about the repair project.
